direct_precedent.name: DKA-SQL
direct_precedent.comparison_gap: DKA-SQL reports BIRD and expert-authored ElecSQL experiments, multiple model scales and competitive/module baselines; MA-SQLGrid currently reports only an internal factorial comparison on one exposed synthetic database.

issues.title: Power-grid maintenance application is not yet externally validated
issues.required_action: Complete dual independent expert review and adjudication of all 91 visible candidates, then create a new access-controlled 50-100-question family-isolated confirmatory set after method freeze and execute both backbones and all four cells once.

issues.title: No competitive evaluation against the DKA-SQL precedent or comparable Text-to-SQL pipelines
issues.required_action: Run fresh same-environment direct, CoT/decomposition, schema-selection/retrieval and verification/repair baselines on a public shared benchmark and the reviewed grid set; reproduce DKA-SQL where feasible without importing incomparable published point estimates.

issues.title: The multi-stage framework is only partially identified by the 2x2 experiment
issues.required_action: Specify each stage algorithmically; report token/schema coverage and omission diagnostics; add no-value-grounding and validator/candidate-replay ablations or narrow all efficacy claims to the two tested factors.

issues.title: Single-state execution equality is insufficient for semantic reliability claims
issues.required_action: Audit a preregistered stratified prediction sample with blinded semantic review or execute predictions on discriminating perturbed/test-suite database states; report false agreement of the current execution metric.

issues.title: Primary data license and public reproducibility path are unresolved
issues.required_action: Obtain GridDB redistribution permission, replace it with distributable data, or provide a licensed regeneration route; perform source-specific license review and deposit permitted artifacts at a permanent DOI/URL.

issues.title: Operational framing lacks a common resource and efficiency experiment
issues.required_action: If operational framing is retained, measure token counts, warm/cold latency, throughput, memory, SQL time and failures on identical hardware; otherwise keep efficiency in Future Work and remove deployment-optimization implications.

issues.title: Length is acceptable but method detail is thin relative to the visual count
issues.required_action: Add only evidence-bearing method, data and experiment detail; do not pad equations or duplicate graphics.

issues.title: GridDB lacks a complete manuscript data card
issues.required_action: Report database dimensions, asset/entity types, question families and complexity, empty results, authoring provenance, generation method and derivation of the 70 normalized template clusters.

issues.title: Framework figures are difficult to read at journal page scale
issues.required_action: Increase labels, simplify nodes and hatching, verify grayscale/color-vision accessibility, and complete manual visual QA.

issues.title: Abstract describes the three-way modifier only as nonzero
issues.required_action: Report the modifier estimate and interval and state that it applies only to the two tested snapshots.

issues.title: Bibliography and terminology need copyediting
issues.required_action: Remove duplicated Proceedings wording and normalize Text-to-SQL terminology, model names, capitalization and dashes.

issues.title: Mandatory front matter remains placeholder text
issues.required_action: Obtain real author-approved identities, affiliations, CRediT roles, funding, conflicts, acknowledgments, repository DOI and AI-use disclosure before submission.

verified_strengths: Complete paired 2x2 design for two audited local backbones
Quarantined contaminated Qwen directory excluded from canonical evidence
Template-cluster intervals and paired multiplicity-aware contrasts
Negative compact-context and backbone-sensitive results retained
Answer-shape conformity separated from semantic execution
External candidates honestly labeled automatic, unreviewed, unsealed and noncanonical
DKA-SQL acknowledged as direct same-journal precedent
Eighteen-page six-section layout and figure/table density compatible with the ten-paper descriptive sample
minimum_revision_gates: Human-reviewed unsealed 91-item set plus a genuinely new sealed external set
Fresh competitive baseline suite including a reproducible direct-precedent comparison where feasible
Component-identification experiments or narrowed framework claims
Semantic robustness audit beyond one database state
Readable figures and complete author-approved front matter
prohibited_interpretations: The current RTS-GMLC or SimBench candidates are human gold or sealed
Two quantized local snapshots establish model-family robustness
All MA-SQLGrid stages have experimentally demonstrated benefit
Local hashes substitute for a licensed public reproducibility package
